name: Gaussian Deformation Field (GauFRe)
aliases: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting with static component
definition: A dynamic scene representation that augments 3D Gaussian Splatting with a time-conditioned forward-warping deformation field. Unlike NeRFs which use backward warps (querying canonical space from spatio-temporal coordinates), GauFRe stores Gaussians in a canonical space and uses a field to output deformed attributes for each time step t.
summary: GauFRe is a dynamic scene representation that augments 3D Gaussian Splatting with a time-conditioned forward-warping deformation field, explicitly separating static and deformable Gaussians to prevent capacity waste and noise.
